text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize amendments to the existing parking regulations on the both sides of Tippett Road. The proposed amendments to the existing parking regulations will address the concerns residents on Tippett Road have regarding vehicles displaying accessible permits from parking on both sides of the street and the safe flow of two-way traffic.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing prohibited parking at all times on the east side of Tippett Road, between Wilson Avenue and a point 132 metres south. 2. Rescinded the existing prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Tippett Road, between Wilson Avenue and the south end of Tippett Road. 3. Prohibited standing at all times on the east side of Tippett Road, between Wilson Avenue and a point 132 metres south. 4. Prohibited standing at all times on the west side of Tippett Road, between Wilson Avenue and the south end of Tippett Road.
